title: Detection of m6A in single cultured cells using scDART-seq
protocol: Culture HEK293T cells on a 15 cm plate in growth medium until they are at approximately 80% confluency.
Transfect viral vectors by adding 1 mL OPTI-MEM to a sterile 15 mL tube.
Add plasmids: 26.75 μg of TLCV2-APOBEC1-YTH (or TLCV2-APOBEC1-YTHmut), 20 μg of psPAX2, and 6.25 μg of pMD2.G to the tube.
Add 3 μg of jet-PEI solution to the tube and gently mix.
Incubate the mixture at 23°C for 30 min.
Apply the solution dropwise to cells and culture them at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 24 hours.
Aspirate the medium, add 20 mL of fresh growth medium, and continue culturing at 37°C with 5% CO2 for an additional 48 hours.
Sterilize ultracentrifuge tubes with 70% ethanol and allow them to air dry in a biosafety cabinet.
Aspirate the medium from cells, transfer it into a 50 mL conical tube, and centrifuge at 5,000 × g for 10 minutes.
Remove the supernatant and filter it through a 0.45 μm nylon filter.
Add filtered medium to ultracentrifuge tubes.
Carefully add 4 mL of sucrose solution to the bottom of each ultracentrifuge tube using a 5 mL serological pipette without mixing layers.
Fill the tubes with PBS to about three-quarters of their height, ensuring all tubes are of equal weight on a balance.
Centrifuge at 19,700 rpm for 2 hours at 4°C in a Beckman SW28 swinging bucket rotor.
Decant supernatant into 10% bleach.
Leave tube inverted on Kimwipes for ∼5 min.
Use vacuum carefully to remove beads of supernatant on the bottom of the tube without aspirating the viral pellet.
Add 100 μL of PBS to the bottom of each tube.
Resuspend by incubating 16–18 h at 4°C in the dark, with rocking.
Centrifuge at 7,000 × g for 1 min at 4°C.
Transfer to a new tube.
Aliquot into 30 μL aliquots on ice.
Freeze in dry ice/ethanol bath and store at −80°C.
Culture HEK293T cells on 60 mm plate in DMEM + 10% FBS until the cells are at about 70% confluency in 3 mL of medium.
Apply 30 μL of resuspended virus to medium.
Culture cells at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 24 h.
Aspirate medium and add 2 mL of selection medium.
Culture cells at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 7 days, replacing with fresh selection medium daily.
After 7 days of puromycin selection, add 500 μL of trypsin.
Incubate at 37°C for 5 min to make a single cell suspension.
Resuspend in 10 mL of growth medium.
Count cells using a hemacytometer or automated cell counter.
Make serial dilutions using growth medium until cells are at a concentration of 1 cell per 200 μL.
Plate 150 μL of the cell suspension per well on 10 96-well plates.
Identify and label wells containing only a single cell using an inverted microscope.
Culture cells at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Identify and culture colonies growing from wells containing single cells.
Expand cells until at least a confluent 10 cm plate is obtained.
Plate 200,000 cells of each inducible APOBEC1-YTH- and APOBEC1-YTHmut-expressing clonal stable cell line on separate 10 cm plates.
Culture the plated cells for 24 hours.
Treat with 1 μg/mL of doxycycline.
Culture the treated cells for an additional 24 hours.
Assess the percentage of cells expressing GFP using fluorescent microscopy.
Select only those cell lines where approximately 100% of the cells express GFP.
Isolate RNA from the selected cell lines.
Aspirate the medium from the plates.
Rinse the plates with cold PBS.
Pour off excess PBS.
Use a cell scraper to harvest cells and transfer them into a 1.5 mL tube.
Centrifuge the sample at 2,000 × g for 1 minute.
Remove PBS from the pellet and add 1 mL of Trizol.
Pipette to mix and homogenize the Trizol solution.
Incubate the mixture at 23°C for 5 minutes.
Add 200 μL of chloroform to the sample.
Vortex the mixture for 10–15 seconds.
Centrifuge the sample at 13,000 × g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer 400 μL of the top aqueous layer into a new tube.
Add 500 μL of isopropanol to the transferred layer and mix by inverting.
Incubate the mixture at 23°C for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge the sample at 13,000 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 70% ethanol.
Vortex to dislodge the RNA pellet from the bottom of the tube.
Centrifuge the sample at 13,000 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove all of the supernatant and air dry for approximately 5 minutes.
Resuspend the pellet in 90 μL of RNase-free water.
Add 10 μL of sodium acetate solution to each tube containing RNA solubilized in 90 μL of water.
Add 2 μL of DNaseI to each tube and mix.
Incubate the mixture at 37°C for 15 minutes.
Add 10 μL of sodium acetate solution to each sample.
Add 250 μL of 100% ethanol to each sample.
Incubate the samples at −80°C for 1 hour.
Centrifuge the samples at 13,000 × g for 15 minutes at 4°C to pellet RNA.
Completely remove the supernatant and air dry for approximately 5 minutes.
Resuspend the pellet in 90 μL of RNase-free water.
Quantify RNA using Qubit RNA BR Assay.
Synthesize cDNA using iScript Supermix in 0.2 mL PCR tubes.
PCR amplify the region surrounding ACTB C1223 in 0.2 mL PCR tubes.
Separate amplified fragment using a 1% agarose gel (w/v).
Extract the ∼150 bp fragment from the gel.
Purify DNA using QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit.
Send purified DNA for Sanger sequencing using the ActinFwd primer.
Observe induction of C-to-T mutation at C1223 in doxycycline-treated APOBEC1-YTH-expressing cell lines.
Collect RNA less than 36 hours after transgene induction.

Plate 200,000 cells of inducible APOBEC1-YTH- and APOBEC1-YTHmut-expressing stable HEK293T cells from clonal cell lines selected in the previous section on separate 10 cm plates for a total of 2 plates.
When cells are approximately 70% confluent, aspirate medium and add 10 mL of growth medium with 1 μg/mL doxycycline and incubate at 37°C for 24 h.
Prepare 3 mL of SMART-seq HT lysis buffer the day before cell sorting.
Aliquot 1 μL into each well of 7 384-well PCR plates and cover with foil adhesive plate covers, storing on ice until ready for use.
Generate a single cell suspension for sorting individual cells.
Aspirate medium from cells and add 10 mL of sterile PBS.
Repeat step to ensure all cells are in single cell suspension.
Aspirate PBS and add 2 mL of TrypLE.
Incubate at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 5 min to dissociate cells.
Add 12 mL of flow buffer.
Gently pipette cells up and down 5–10 times with a 10 mL pipette to break up clumps.
Transfer cells to 15 mL conical tubes.
Count cells using hemacytometer or automated cell counter.
Add 2 million cells to a 1.5 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 1,000 × g for 3 min at 23°C.
Remove as much supernatant as possible without disturbing the pellet.
Resuspend pellet in 200 μL of flow buffer using a wide-bore P1000 pipette tip set to 150 μL.
Add 2 μL of near-IR LIVE/DEAD viability dye.
Incubate in the dark for 5 min at 23°C.
Add 2 μL (4 units) of DNaseI.
Gently mix by pipetting with a wide-bore P1000 pipette tip.
Incubate for 15 min at 23°C in the dark.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation at 1,000 × g for 3 min.
Remove as much supernatant as possible without disturbing the pellet.
Add 1 mL of flow buffer and gently dissociate the pellet with a wide-bore P1000 pipette tip.
Filter cells using a 40 μm nylon filter.
Sort 1 viable cell per well of each plate using a FACS Aria II.
Cover the plate immediately after sorting is finished with a foil adhesive plate cover.
Spin the plate at 1,000 × g for 1 min in a swinging bucket centrifuge.
Place the plate on dry ice immediately after spinning.
Perform reverse transcription according to the manufacturer’s protocol using the Takara SMART-seq HT Kit.
Amplify cDNA according to the manufacturer’s protocol using the Takara SMART-seq HT Kit.
Clean up post-PCR products for sequencing library preparation.
Thaw one of the 384-well plates with sorted single cells on ice.
Centrifuge plate at 2,000 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Incubate plate in a thermocycler set to 72°C for 3 min.
Immediately remove the plate from the thermocycler and incubate on ice for 2 min.
Mix 1 μL of One-step mastermix with each sample while on ice.
Cover the plate with an adhesive plate cover.
Incubate in a thermocycler with lid set to 105°C for reverse transcription and cDNA amplification.
Store the plate at −20°C if not proceeding immediately, covered with foil adhesive plate covers.
Add 5.5 μL of nuclease-free water per well (7.5 μL total volume).
Transfer samples from a 384-well plate to four 96-well PCR plates.
Add 7.5 μL AMPure XP beads to each well in the 96-well plate and mix by pipetting.
Incubate at 23°C for 8 minutes.
Place on a 96-well plate magnetic rack for 5 minutes or until solution is clear.
Remove supernatant from each well using a multi-channel pipette.
Add 200 μL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol to each well.
Incubate in ethanol for 30 seconds.
Remove the ethanol supernatant with a multichannel P200 pipette, followed by removing as much ethanol as possible from the same row using a P10 multichannel pipette.
Do not over-dry the beads.
Change tip on aspirator between wells.
Add 17 μL elution buffer using a multichannel pipette.
Mix by pipetting after adding elution buffer.
Incubate at 23°C for 5 min after adding elution buffer to the last row.
Place on a 96-well plate magnetic rack for 2 min or until supernatant is clear.
Transfer 15 μL from each well to a new plate.
Store plates at −20°C with foil adhesive plate covers if not proceeding immediately.
Use Qubit 1× dsDNA HS Assay Kit to quantify the concentration of cDNA.
Verify expected size distribution of cDNA fragments using Agilent High Sensitivity DNA Kit on the Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer.
Dilute cDNA in each well to a concentration of 200 pg/μL using elution buffer.
Add 1.875 μL of the tagmentation premix to each well in the top-left quadrant of a 384-well plate.
Add 0.625 μL of 200 pg/μL cDNA to each well.
Seal the plate with an adhesive plate cover and place it in a thermocycler for 10 min at 55°C.
Hold the samples at 10°C.
As soon as the samples reach 10°C, add 0.625 μL of NT Buffer to each well.
Seal the plate again with an adhesive plate cover.
Centrifuge the plate at 2,000 × g for 1 min at 23°C.
Incubate the plate at 23°C for 5 min.
Add 1.88 μL of NPM master mix to each well.
Add 0.625 μL of nuclease-free water to each well.
Add 0.625 μL of duplexed, Nextera-compatible indexing primers to each well.
Seal the plate with an adhesive plate cover.
Incubate in a thermocycler with lid set to 105°C.
Add 9.375 μL of nuclease-free water to each well (totaling 12.5 μL).
Transfer samples to a 96-well plate.
Add 7.5 μL AMPure XP beads to each well.
Mix by pipetting.
Incubate at 23°C for 8 min.
Place on a 96-well plate magnetic rack for 5 min or until solution is clear.
Remove supernatant.
Add 200 μL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol to each well.
Incubate in ethanol for 30 s.
Remove supernatant.
Add 80% ethanol.
Using a multichannel p200 pipette, remove supernatant from one row.
Use a p10 multichannel pipette to remove as much ethanol as possible from the same row.
Change tip on aspirator between wells.
Add 17 μL elution buffer using a multichannel pipette and mix by pipetting.
Repeat steps for all rows on plate.
Incubate at 23°C for 5 min after elution buffer is added to the last row.
Place on a 96-well plate magnetic rack for 2 min or until supernatant is clear.
Transfer 15 μL from each well to a new plate.
Cover plates with foil adhesive plate covers if storing at −20°C.
Use the Qubit 1× dsDNA HS Assay Kit to quantify cDNA concentration in all wells.
Verify expected size distribution of cDNA fragments using the Agilent High Sensitivity DNA Kit on the Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer.
Pool samples for sequencing, ensuring equal molar representation in the final library.
Quantify pooled sample using the Qubit 1× dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
Assess fragment sizes of pooled samples using the Agilent High Sensitivity DNA Kit.
Perform next-generation Illumina sequencing.
